risks.risk: Steam function may be weak or not working (clogged nozzle/valve, heater fault).
risks.proof: Short video of the iron plugged in, heating, and producing continuous steam from the nozzle/soleplate for at least 30–60 seconds.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully proven for steam performance (worst case: weak/no steam).

risks.risk: Water tank/leak issues (cracks, poor seal, leaking from base).
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing the water tank filled and a brief tilt test over a tissue to confirm no leaking.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as potential leak risk until leak-free is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Soleplate condition (scratches, burnt marks, residue) affecting ironing quality.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the soleplate/steam holes from straight-on and at an angle.
risks.if_unproven: Price it assuming normal wear and possible residue/scratches.
